title: Chemnitzer Straße, Schulzendorf
description:
** ACCOMMODATION LOCATED IN 15732 SCHULZENDORF-BERLIN **

Check out this cosy flat in Berlin!

This property boasts a cosy and neat design. The interiors are bright and colourful, creating a warm atmosphere.

This flat has room for 4 people and is part of a floor (144 m2) that also includes another flat and 2 private rooms of which one is already being rented by a Columbian woman. The whole property has room for a maximum of 10 people. The rent price is only for 2 people (€800 per person). If 3 people were to rent this flat, the price would increase to €1700 per month, and if 4 people were to rent it, the price would increase to €1800 per month. The deposit is equivalent to one month's rent.

This amazing listing features iconic Mediterranean high ceilings, large windows that brighten the living spaces, amazing furniture, a bathroom with whirlpool, a fully equipped kitchen to cook anything you please, a garden, in other words, a great place to come home to!

This separate flat provides a comfortable double foldaway bed, so you will have all the space you need, a small kitchen, a small bathroom, a sofa bed, a TV, a closet with enough space to arrange all your belongings, and you are free to make it your place to relax and reset!

The neighbourhood is very tranquil, you'll be able to go on peaceful strolls at anytime of the day. Within walking distance you will be able to reach the bus stop, the supermarket, which makes it a very comfortable location.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
